Name: Pisco Sour
Ingredients: Barsol Quebranta Pisco, Lime, Sugar, Egg Whites
Instructions: Combine pisco, lime, simple syrup, and egg white in a cocktail shaker without ice. Dry shake for 10 seconds. Add ice and shake again until chilled. Double strain into a chilled glass.
Garnish: 3 drops of Angostura bitters on the foam

Name: Penicillin
Ingredients: Dewar's Portuguese Smooth, Islay Scotch, Honey, Ginger, Lemon
Instructions: Muddle fresh ginger in a shaker. Add blended scotch, lemon juice, and honey syrup. Shake with ice. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube. Float Islay scotch on top.

Name: Hotel Nacionale
Ingredients: Short Story Rum, Apricot, Pineapple, Citrus
Instructions: Add rum, apricot liqueur, pineapple juice, and lime juice to a shaker with ice. Shake well. Strain into a chilled coupe glass.

Name: Bee's Knees
Ingredients: Short Story Gin, Himalayan Honey, Lemon
Instructions: Combine gin, lemon juice, and honey syrup in a shaker with ice. Shake until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

Name: Paper Plane
Ingredients: Weller Special Reserve, Aperol, Amaro, Lemon
Instructions: Combine bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino, and fresh lemon juice in a shaker with ice. Shake until chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe glass.

Name: Tommy's Margarita
Ingredients: Camino Silver, Agave Nectar, Lime
Instructions: Combine tequila, lime juice, and agave nectar in a shaker with ice. Shake well. Strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice.

Name: Sazerac
Ingredients: Whisky (Blended/Rye), Cinnamon, Apple, Bitters
Instructions: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe (optional) or use a cinnamon-apple reduction. Stir whiskey, simple syrup, and bitters with ice. Strain into the prepared glass.

Name: Chamomile Negroni
Ingredients: Gin infused with Chamomile, Campari, Sweet Vermouth
Instructions: Combine chamomile-infused gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth in a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Garnish: Dried chamomile flowers or orange peel

Name: Chawanprash Whisky Cocktail
Ingredients: Whisky, Chawanprash (herbal jam), Spices
Instructions: Incorporate Chawanprash into a whisky sour or old fashioned base. Shake or stir to ensure the jam is well-integrated.

Name: Shoyu Ramen Cocktail
Ingredients: Tequila, Sake, Shiro Miso, Savory elements
Instructions: Combine tequila and sake with a shiro miso syrup. Shake with ice to balance the savory and sweet notes. Strain into a chilled glass.

Name: Native (Local Ingredient Focused)
Ingredients: Local Himalayan flavors, seasonal fruits
Instructions: Varies by season. Focus on hyper-local ingredients like sea buckthorn or wild berries.

Name: Turmeric Gin & Tonic
Ingredients: Turmeric-infused Gin, Orange Liqueur, Lime Juice, Tonic Water
Instructions: Build the infused gin, orange liqueur, and lime juice in a highball glass over ice. Top with tonic water and stir gently.

Name: Chilli Fellow
Ingredients: Gin, fresh grapefruit juice, lime juice, Bellary chilli syrup, tonic water
Instructions: Combine gin, grapefruit juice, lime juice, and chilli syrup in a shaker with ice. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass over fresh ice. Top with tonic water.

Name: 3am Chai
Ingredients: Brandy, masala tea syrup, lime juice
Instructions: Shake brandy, masala tea syrup, and lime juice with ice. Strain into a chilled glass.

Name: Madikeri Sour
Ingredients: Whisky, passion tea syrup, lime juice, egg white (optional)
Instructions: Combine whisky, passion tea syrup, lime juice, and egg white (if using) in a shaker. Dry shake for 10 seconds. Add ice and shake again until chilled. Strain into a rocks glass.
Garnish: Dried tea leaves or lemon twist

Name: Mysuru Parimala
Ingredients: White rum, clarified banana extract, lime juice, sandalwood bitters
Instructions: Shake white rum, clarified banana, lime juice, and sandalwood bitters with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass.

Name: Full Toit Kaapi
Ingredients: Vodka, vanilla ice cream, coffee, cream, butterscotch and vanilla syrup
Instructions: Blend or shake vodka, vanilla ice cream, coffee, cream, and syrups together. Serve chilled.

Name: BKK - BLR
Ingredients: Gin, homemade lemongrass syrup, strawberry syrup, tonic water
Instructions: Combine gin and syrups in a highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently. Top with tonic water.

Name: Watermelon Sugar. Hi!
Ingredients: Vodka, chocolate syrup, cinnamon syrup, fresh watermelon, lemon juice
Instructions: Muddle watermelon with lemon juice. Add vodka and syrups. Shake with ice. Strain into a chilled glass.

Name: Kaapi Martini
Ingredients: Aged rum, filter kaapi (coffee), Coffee liqueur
Instructions: Shake aged rum, filter kaapi, and coffee liqueur with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass.

Name: Mangaa
Ingredients: Vodka, Aam Panna (raw mango), cumin, salt, soda
Instructions: Combine vodka and Aam Panna in a glass with ice. Add cumin and salt. Stir well and top with soda.
Garnish: Raw mango slice or mint sprig

Name: Copper Monkey
Ingredients: Whisky, orange juice, passion fruit, bitters, mint
Instructions: Shake whisky, orange juice, and passion fruit syrup with ice. Strain into a copper mug or rocks glass filled with crushed ice. Top with bitters.

Name: Maaza-Wars
Ingredients: Rum, Maaza (mango drink), lime, mint, soda
Instructions: Build rum, Maaza, and lime juice in a highball glass over ice. Top with soda and stir.

Name: Aacharoska
Ingredients: Vodka, lime juice, fresh mint, ginger, Indian lime pickle
Instructions: Muddle ginger and mint with lime pickle. Add vodka and lime juice. Shake with ice and strain into a rocks glass.
Garnish: Lime wedge and a touch of pickle

Name: Deconstructed Moscow Mule
Ingredients: Vodka, ginger ale, bitters, lime
Instructions: Served as a DIY kit. Pour vodka over ice, add lime juice and bitters. Top with ginger ale.

Name: L.L.I.I.T (Longest Long Island Iced Tea)
Ingredients: Vodka, Gin, Tequila, Rum, Triple Sec, Cranberry juice, Apple juice
Instructions: Combine all spirits and juices in a tall cylinder glass. Stir gently.

Name: South Pacific Rim
Ingredients: Rum, Pineapple juice, Orange juice, Grenadine
Instructions: Shake rum and juices with ice. Strain into a tiki-style glass or highball.

Name: Cosmo-Explosion
Ingredients: Vodka, Cranberry juice, Triple Sec, Cotton Candy
Instructions: Shake vodka, cranberry, and triple sec. Pour over a glass filled with cotton candy.
